noeuds.role: Replaces the text of a Text object. Start with = to show a calculation.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Sentence name (in the game texts)
noeuds.role: Writes into the Text object the sentence matching the key, from the dialogue file (dialogues.txt). Several languages: write “hello.en = Hello”, “hello.fr = Bonjour”…; the game uses the language in the “langue” variable, otherwise the phone language. “\n” = new line.
noeuds.exemple: the key “hello_merchant” shows the merchant's line.

noeuds.role: Adds text at the end of a variable of type Text.
noeuds.exemple: type a password letter by letter.
